name: Does artificial turf require any maintenance?
description: Artificial turf requires minimal maintenance, including rinsing to remove debris and odors, and occasional brushing to keep blades upright.

mainEntity.name: Does artificial turf require any maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: While artificial turf significantly reduces maintenance compared to natural grass, it is not entirely maintenance-free. Occasional care is needed to keep it looking its best. This includes rinsing with water to remove dust, pollen, and pet odors. Brushing the turf periodically with a stiff-bristled broom or power brush helps to keep the blades standing upright, preventing matting. Promptly removing leaves and debris also ensures optimal drainage and aesthetics. This minimal upkeep extends the lifespan and maintains the appearance of your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Artificial turf requires minimal maintenance, including rinsing to remove debris and odors, and occasional brushing to keep blades upright.
